Dear Customer Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention several inconsistencies I have noticed in my recent travel expense records. 3. **Duplicate entries** – In one instance, the same booking appears twice with slightly different amounts.

**Requested Actions**

- **Audit & Reconciliation** – Please review the above bookings and reconcile the discrepancies against the original payment receipts.  
- **Updated Invoices** – Provide corrected invoices reflecting the accurate charges.  
- **Clarification** – Explain any adjustments or refunds that may have occurred post‑booking.

I have attached screenshots of my credit card statements and the original booking confirmations for your reference. If you require any additional documentation or clarification, please let me know at your earliest convenience.
